gh_entrance.name: Haunted House Plaza
gh_entrance.desc: Beside the haunted house at Chaoye Park

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: (*Click the dialogue box or press Space to advance the story, and use the save button in the top‑left corner to save anytime.*)

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: October 27, 2025, 6:00 PM, Chaoye Park, in front of the haunted house

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: Aaaah that was SO intense!!!

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: You're squeezing my arm too tight.

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: Sis, that was amazing! We have to go again!

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: You were about to cry, and now you're asking for round two? Sure you can handle that?

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: During the Halloween season, the city's most famous Chaoye Park held its annual haunted house carnival, drawing crowds of eager visitors.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: This year's haunted house theme is once again based on American author Edgar Allan Poe's short story "The Masque of the Red Death" — bizarre, opulent, and Gothic in style.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Sidney — your darling little sister — was naturally not one to miss the excitement. Though easily frightened, the haunted house is her annual must-see.

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: Come on, let's go again later! I'll get you a drink!

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Alright, alright. Let's go.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Sidney grabs your wrist and briskly pulls you toward a drink stand with a giant cartoon sign nearby.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Though evening has fallen, the plaza is still bustling. Several NPCs dressed as ghosts and monsters weave through the crowd, making people laugh one moment and scream in terror the next.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Sidney orders you an osmanthus taro bubble tea with double toppings, and a bayberry lychee iced tea for herself.

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: Sis, your favorite! Let's sip slowly, then go on the pirate ship once, then come back and line up again — pretty please?

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: How many times have you seen this show? Wasn't it here last year too?

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: Yeah, but the sets are even more elaborate this year! And the choreography seems different!

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: It is pretty cool. Alright, I'll watch it again with you. Just don't pinch my arm this time!

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: When you circle back, the area in front of the haunted house is in an uproar.

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: Wait, what's going on?

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Staff: "Ladies and gentlemen, we sincerely apologize! Tonight's performance has been suspended due to unforeseen circumstances. The park will compensate you with an evening admission ticket so you may enjoy the show on another date!"

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: What?! It's canceled?!

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Staff: "Please do not gather or queue here. All other park attractions remain open as usual!"

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Disappointed sighs and grumbles ripple through the crowd. Sidney, of course, is among them.

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: Aaaah! Seriously? I wanted to watch it again!

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Excuse me, why has the performance been suspended?

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Staff: "Due to... equipment maintenance. Anyway... please queue up elsewhere."

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Just as you're about to turn and leave, a somewhat familiar figure appears not far away.

introDialogue.speaker: char_andy
introDialogue.t: Hey? Sylva?

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Andy? What are you doing here?

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Five years ago, Andy was a security guard in your neighborhood. Someone falsely accused him of embezzling a resident's lost property, and you helped clear his name — that's how you met. Andy knows you're a capable detective and trusts you completely.

introDialogue.speaker: char_andy
introDialogue.t: Ugh, what a mess. One of the performers vanished without a trace right at showtime, and now everyone's searching.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: A haunted house performer?

introDialogue.speaker: char_andy
introDialogue.t: Yeah, did you see the show? It's the guy playing the Cellist. Name's Victor. We've checked the restrooms, the changing rooms, the makeup room, the prop room — nobody's seen him.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: How long has he been missing?

introDialogue.speaker: char_andy
introDialogue.t: He went missing during tonight's fifth show. It's been over half an hour now.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: It's 19:58 now. You've been searching since then and haven't found him?

introDialogue.speaker: char_andy
introDialogue.t: No — the cast finished that show, saw the audience off at the exit spot, then searched the haunted house themselves and tried calling him. When they couldn't reach him, they told their director Ray, who also couldn't find him, so he came to me.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Are you sure the performer isn't still inside the haunted house?

introDialogue.speaker: char_andy
introDialogue.t: Huh? You mean he might never have come out?

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: The haunted house is packed with props. He could have suddenly fallen ill and collapsed in a corner. Has anyone checked thoroughly?

introDialogue.speaker: char_andy
introDialogue.t: Ray and the performers Aiden and Sunny should have searched twice already — they know the layout well. I haven't checked personally. How about we go take a look?

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: After Andy briefs the staff, he leads you and Sidney inside the haunted house.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: At this moment, the haunted house looks nothing like it does during performances. Every spot is lit up, and the props that were terrifying in the dark now look as crude as children's toys under the lights.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: You pass the Cellist's stage and the Plague Doctor's scene in turn. In a large performance space to your right, you see two performers talking.

introDialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
introDialogue.t: What the heck is up with Vic... nowhere to be found, not even answering his phone... You think they'll dock our pay for not being able to perform?

introDialogue.speaker: char_ayou
introDialogue.t: Probably can't dodge it... And Faye's not here either. This is bad...

introDialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
introDialogue.t: Yeah, of all times...

introDialogue.speaker: char_andy
introDialogue.t: Sunny, Aiden — have you searched everywhere in here?

introDialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
introDialogue.t: Yeah, we looked. It's not that big — where could someone hide?

introDialogue.speaker: char_andy
introDialogue.t: I brought a detective I know. We're going to search again.

introDialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
introDialogue.t: Suit yourselves. I'm tired. I'll rest a bit.

introDialogue.speaker: char_ayou
introDialogue.t: It's a bit messy up ahead. I'll go tidy up.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: You, Sidney, and Andy follow the audience route further in and spot a hidden door in the wall.

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: Where does this door lead?

introDialogue.speaker: char_andy
introDialogue.t: Back toward the entrance. It's more convenient for the performers to move through here.

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: So that's the Cellist's spot?

introDialogue.speaker: char_andy
introDialogue.t: That's right.

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: Speaking of the Cellist — who were those two playing again? And where are the other performers?

introDialogue.speaker: char_andy
introDialogue.t: Haha, there are only three performers here.

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: What? But I remember...

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Sidney starts counting on her fingers.

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: First, the Cellist. Second, the creepy Plague Doctor. Third, the Masked Dancer. Fourth, the mad killer. Fifth and sixth, a dance between a red-robed demon and a woman in white. Seventh, the Hunchback Bell Ringer. That's... seven performers!

introDialogue.speaker: char_andy
introDialogue.t: Nope. Just three.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: If they use this hidden door, three performers could easily play all seven roles.

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: What?!

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: "Yes! Exactly! This lady is brilliant!" A man walks over smiling, speaking to you and your sister.

introDialogue.speaker: char_andy
introDialogue.t: Ray, this is my detective friend Sylva, and the lovely young lady beside her is Sylva's sister Sidney. This is Ray, the park's Performance Director.

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: Ah... tonight's show... I'm so sorry. Victor must have run off for some emergency. I'll give him a piece of my mind when he gets back.

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: Mr. Shi, did you create this show? I absolutely loved it!

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: Wow, thank you! Your love is what drives us to keep improving!

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: Are there really only three performers? How can three people pull off seven roles?

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: Hahaha! It all comes down to the ingenious design of our Performance Department!

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: First, do you know what the theme of tonight's performance is? (*Please select the correct answer, supports mouse or W/S key selection and Enter confirmation*)

choices.question: What is the theme of this performance?

options.text: A The Fall of the House of Usher
B The Pit and the Pendulum
C The Masque of the Red Death

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: Yes! The story is based on the famous work by American author Edgar Allan Poe.

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: The tale tells of a prince and nobles who hold a lavish masquerade ball inside a castle to escape a devastating plague, only to be invaded by the plague incarnate — the "Red Death" — and all perish from infection.

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: We designed the whole story like this: at the entrance to the masquerade, a Cellist opens the show with music; then, a Plague Doctor in a bird-beak mask spreads terror about the plague through the corridor.

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: Next, a dancer's movements grow increasingly erratic until she collapses; around the banquet table lie the corpses of plague-stricken guests, while the Mad Prince strangles one with a rope.

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: Further in, the Red Death dances a duet with the Prince's Wife. The Red Death, in a billowing robe, props up the Prince's Wife by her arms. Though she appears to dance with him, her body has gone rigid — swaying like a corpse.

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: Finally, the Prince's loyal Bell Ringer watches a procession of ghosts — the audience — approaching. He realizes the plague has breached the castle and tolls the final death knell.

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: Then the audience exits in order.

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: So that's how it works! How brilliant!

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: We used a key element from the story to achieve our "actor consolidation" design. What do you think it is?

choices.question: Which element enables the actor consolidation?

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: Exactly! By using the masquerade ball concept, we let performers change costumes rapidly and switch identities without the audience noticing. That's how three actors can pull off seven roles!

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: That's incredible! How do they actually do it?

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: Look — this is the floor plan of our haunted house. (*Open the 'Evidence' panel on the right to view, then click the pin icon in the upper-right corner to close*)

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: The six numbers represent six spots — the numbering is also the order in which the audience visits them. Each area is relatively self-contained. When the audience gathers in one area, the performer there begins their act. Each performance segment lasts 3-5 minutes.

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: We make every costume set easy to put on and take off, and performers wear a black base layer underneath. The costume for each space is pre-placed in a dim corner of that room.

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: While the audience is absorbed in another spot's performance, the performer slips through a hidden door or circles behind the audience to reach the next spot, quickly puts on the costume, and waits.

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: Unless the story demands it, performers never pass through multiple spots in a row. This keeps their movements from being easily noticed by the audience.

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: Can you figure out how the performers cover the entire show?

introDialogue.speaker: char_andy
introDialogue.t: You could start with the performer at Spot 1 — the Cellist.

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: After playing the Cellist, which spot would be most convenient for the performer at Spot 1 to go to next?

choices.question: Where does the performer at Spot 1 go next?

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: Correct! Now, after playing the Plague Doctor, which spot can the performer at Spot 2 go to next?

choices.question: Where does the performer at Spot 2 go next?

options.reply: That would be a bit odd...
That would be a bit odd...

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: Yes. And next, after finishing the solo dance, which spot does the performer at Spot 3 go to for the duet?

choices.question: Where does the performer at Spot 3 go next?

introDialogue.speaker: char_shihui
introDialogue.t: Right! Finally — the Bell Ringer at Spot 6. Which of the three original performers — 1, 2, or 3 — plays this role?

introDialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
introDialogue.t: So among the three performers, each plays at least two roles, and one of them even plays three roles! Which performer plays the three roles of "Plague Doctor," "Mad Prince," and "Bell Ringer"? (*Drag a 'Character' card from the right panel to the dashed box, then click the confirm button*)
introDialogue.autoPresent: Which performer played three roles in this show?

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Why couldn't Victor have played the Plague Doctor and the other roles? (*You can present any card from the right — 'Characters,' 'Evidence,' and 'Testimony'*)
dialogue.autoPresent: Present the clue that proves which role Victor played

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Because the testimony states that the cast saw the audience off from the Bell Ringer's spot, meaning the missing Victor could not have been the Bell Ringer. And there's another sentence that can also prove what role Victor played.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Victor's disappearance was noticed by his fellow cast member. The entire show has only one duet segment that requires two performers working together. So Victor was likely one of the performers in that duet.

options.text: B "Fellow cast members noticed he was gone but completed the performance anyway."
C "The cast searched for Victor on their own to no avail."

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Then why couldn't Sunny be the one playing three roles?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Because Sunny is the only female — and the only "dancer." She most likely had to contribute to both the solo at Spot 3 and the duet at Spot 5.

dialogue.speaker: char_andy
dialogue.t: Wow, as expected of Detective Sylva. That's brilliant!

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: You're amazing, sis!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: You're all enjoying the lively analysis of the performance when a sudden scream shatters the cheerful mood.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: AAAAAAAH!!!

dialogue.speaker: char_andy
dialogue.t: What?!

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: V-V-Vic is... he's DEAD!!!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: October 27, 2025, 8:18 PM, Chaoye Park, inside the haunted house

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Around the Prince's lavish banquet table lie the bodies of guests, twisted in grotesque poses on the tabletop and floor. A terrified Aiden points beneath the long table.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: It is the missing performer — Victor.

dialogue.speaker: char_shihui
dialogue.t: Aah! Quick, call the police!

dialogue.speaker: char_andy
dialogue.t: Right... I'll call them right now! Everyone, stay where you are!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: October 27, 2025, 8:32 PM, Chaoye Park, beside the haunted house

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: Sylva? What are you doing here?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Lyra! Long time no see!

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: Every time you show up, something crazy happens. And I mean crazy.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Ah... haha... sorry about that.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Hi, Lyra~

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: Sidney! Good to see you. How did the two of you get dragged into another case?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Well, it's Halloween, and Sidney wanted to get a thrill at the haunted house, and then...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Andy and Ray recount to Lyra everything that happened after Victor went missing. Lyra takes careful notes as the medical examiner performs a preliminary examination of the body.

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: The prelim report just came back. The victim was strangled to death. Estimated time of death is between 18:15 and 19:15.

dialogue.speaker: char_shihui
dialogue.t: Speaking of time — the haunted house shows start at 17:00, one every half hour. Each performance runs about 20 minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: What about the other 10 minutes?

dialogue.speaker: char_shihui
dialogue.t: Those 10 minutes are for everyone to return to their spots, do a quick reset of the props, and catch a short break.

dialogue.speaker: char_andy
dialogue.t: Based on the autopsy, the victim was killed between the third and fifth shows.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Based on what the other performers said, we can actually narrow the time range further.
dialogue.autoPresent: Which piece of evidence/testimony can further narrow the time of death?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Fellow cast members said Victor was noticed missing during the 19:00 show, and the previous performances went off without issue. This means Victor's time of death is...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Victor was noticed missing during the 19:00 show. His death must therefore have occurred during...

choices.question: The time of death was during...

options.text: A The third and fourth shows
C The fourth and fifth shows

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: Alright. So the most likely time window for the crime is during the fourth and fifth shows — that is, between 18:30 and 19:30. Now, combining that with the autopsy report, we can narrow it further to...

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: We can narrow it further to...

dialogue.speaker: char_shihui
dialogue.t: So the crime scene was right here in this performance space...

dialogue.speaker: char_shihui
dialogue.t: How terrifying! The killer must know our show inside and out...

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Using the gaps between performances to commit murder?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Besides the performers here, does anyone else know the details of the show?

dialogue.speaker: char_shihui
dialogue.t: Yes — the staff all know to some degree, and so do understudy performers, the prop team, and others.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: That's quite a long list.

dialogue.speaker: char_andy
dialogue.t: Oh right — some audience members from the fifth show mentioned that when they first entered, the set looked great and the music was playing, but it felt like something was missing...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Which means the Cellist wasn't at his post by then.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Um... during the fourth show, Victor was there and we performed as normal. But by the fifth show he was gone.

dialogue.speaker: char_shihui
dialogue.t: Sunny here plays the Dancer. She and Victor — who plays the Red Death — meet at Spot 5 for a duet.

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: So based on Sunny's testimony, the evidence that can further narrow the time range is...

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: The evidence that can narrow the time frame is...
dialogue.autoPresent: Which evidence narrows the time frame?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: The approximate durations for each spot are: 2 min, 3 min, 5 min, 3 min, 3 min, 4 min. So the performance at Spot 5 ends roughly...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: The approximate show times for each spot are: 2 minutes, 3 minutes, 5 minutes, 3 minutes, 3 minutes, 4 minutes. So Spot 5's performance ends at roughly...

options.text: A About 16 minutes after the show starts
B About 18 minutes after the show starts
C About 20 minutes after the show starts

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: If Sunny's testimony is truthful, the time of death can be narrowed further to...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: If Sunny is telling the truth, the time of death narrows to...

choices.question: Narrow the time of death to?

options.reply: Seems like math isn't sis's strong suit...
Seems like math isn't sis's strong suit...

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: Right. But as our primary suspects, Aiden and Sunny's testimony can't be taken at face value yet.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Exactly. So if we question the two performers separately and find contradictions in their stories, we might find a breakthrough.

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: My colleagues just finished searching the corridors — nothing suspicious. Let's search each room of the haunted house first, then question everyone individually.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: The night air at Chaoye Park is chilly, the wind cutting straight down your collar.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: There's a low hum of noise around you — staff are helping the police evacuate visitors.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: The performers huddle together, their faces grim as they murmur about what just happened.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: The questioning is about to begin. Gotta steel yourself.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: The wind cuts through you. You press your palms to your cheeks. Lyra steps out of the haze.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: It's going to be a long night.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: (*End of this section — click to continue*)
